description: InferenceResult -> canonical Event identity. Same event_idempotency_key + same input/output digest yields the same canonical_event_id (idempotent). A second record with the same key but a different output_digest is a stable conflict (no canonical Event). A late/wrong binding_generation is rejected. Cross-language runners (Go, Rust, C++) must derive the identical canonical_event_id and commit_status from the fence dimensions.

expected.idempotency_rule: same key + same input_digest + same output_digest -> return original canonical_event_id with commit_status=idempotent
expected.conflict_rule: same key + different output_digest -> commit_status=conflict, no canonical_event_id, reason_code=DIGEST_CONFLICT
expected.late_generation_rule: binding_generation lower than current durable -> commit_status=rejected, reason_code=LATE_GENERATION
expected.quality_projection_rule: quality=not-measurable|gap|invalid -> not projected as normal committed event; explicit status namespace
